description: This file provides a client class for interacting with the WhatsApp Cloud API, managing WebRTC calls, handling webhook verification and requests, and coordinating call lifecycle events such as connect and terminate. It integrates with WebRTC connections and WhatsApp API endpoints to facilitate real-time communication features in a larger application.

classes.name: WhatsAppClient
classes.description: A client for managing WhatsApp Cloud API interactions, WebRTC call setup, webhook verification, and event handling for calls and disconnects.

methods.name: None __init__( self, whatsapp_token: str, phone_number_id: str, session: aiohttp.ClientSession, ice_servers: Optional[List[IceServer]] = None, whatsapp_secret: Optional[str] = None, )
methods.description: Initializes the WhatsAppClient with tokens, session, and optional ICE servers and secret.

methods.name: update_ice_servers(self, ice_servers: Optional[List[IceServer]] = None)
methods.description: Updates the list of ICE servers used for WebRTC connections.

methods.name: update_whatsapp_secret(self, whatsapp_secret: Optional[str] = None)
methods.description: Updates the WhatsApp APP secret used for webhook signature validation.

methods.name: update_whatsapp_token(self, whatsapp_token: str)
methods.description: Updates the WhatsApp API access token.

methods.name: update_whatsapp_phone_number_id(self, phone_number_id: str)
methods.description: Updates the WhatsApp phone number ID.

methods.name: None terminate_all_calls(self)
methods.description: Terminates all ongoing WhatsApp calls by sending API termination requests and disconnecting WebRTC sessions.

methods.name: int handle_verify_webhook_request( self, params: Dict[str, str], expected_verification_token: str )
methods.description: Handles verification requests from WhatsApp webhook by validating mode, token, and challenge.

methods.name: _validate_whatsapp_webhook_request(self, raw_body: bytes, sha256_signature: str)
methods.description: Validates the webhook request's signature using HMAC SHA-256.

methods.name: bool handle_webhook_request( self, request: WhatsAppWebhookRequest, connection_callback: Optional[Callable[[SmallWebRTCConnection], Awaitable[None]]] = None, raw_body: Optional[bytes] = None, sha256_signature: Optional[str] = None, )
methods.description: Processes incoming webhook events, handling connect and terminate call events, and optionally invoking callbacks.

methods.name: str _filter_sdp_for_whatsapp(self, sdp: str)
methods.description: Filters SDP to include only SHA-256 fingerprints for WhatsApp compatibility.

methods.name: SmallWebRTCConnection _handle_connect_event(self, call: WhatsAppConnectCall)
methods.description: Handles a connect event by establishing a WebRTC connection, pre-accepting, and accepting the call via API.

methods.name: bool _handle_terminate_event(self, call: WhatsAppTerminateCall)
methods.description: Handles a terminate event by disconnecting WebRTC and cleaning call resources.
